1. (Currently amended) A modular humeral implant comprising a first humeral surface component removably attached to a second stem component, wherein said first and second components are configured to be implanted in a human humerus bone.

2. (Currently amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a humeral surface component and said second component is a removably attached stem component.

3. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature, and wherein said humeral surface component is distinct from natural bone tissue.

4. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said coronal radius of curvature has a range of 10 to 50 mm.

5. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said axial radius of curvature has a range of from 10 to 50 mm.

6. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component has a depth with a range of from 5 to 40 mm and is made of an artificial material.

7. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface has a thickness with a range of from 0.1 to 10 mm.

8. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein a ratio of a depth of said humeral surface to said coronal radius of curvature is from about 0.7 to about 0.9.

9. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component is spherically or elliptically shaped and is made of an artificial material distinct from natural bone.

10. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component is made of a material selected from the group consisting of cobalt chrome alloy, ceramic, metal, and magnet materials.

11. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component further comprises fins or spikes on a concave undersurface of said humeral surface component, wherein said fins or spikes are shown in the drawings.

12. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 further comprising a concave undersurface on said humeral surface component for receiving bony ingrowth material.

13. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component has a smooth articulating surface and is made of an artificial material.

14. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said stem component has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

15. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 14 wherein said stem component is made of a material selected from the group consisting of titanium, stainless steel, tantalum, porous metal and trabecular metal.

16. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 15 wherein said stem component further comprises a smooth, textured or threaded surface.

17. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 16 wherein said stem component is round, square, or triangular in cross-section.

18. (Original) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises fins.

19. (Original) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a bony ingrowth surface.

20. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said stem component is provided in a plurality of different fixed lengths, each configured to extend from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus, and wherein a user selects and removably attaches a stem of appropriate length for a particular patient.

21. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said stem component.

22. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said stem component by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper and a screw.

23. (Cancelled)

24. (Cancelled)

25. (Cancelled)

26. (Cancelled)

27. (Currently amended) A glenohumeral joint implant system comprising a transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus and a modular humeral implant adapted to be implanted in the glenohumeral joint.

28. (Currently amended) The glenohumeral joint implant system of claim 27 wherein said implant is a humeral implant as defined in claim 1.

29. (Currently amended) A humerus bone implant comprising a modular implant with a humeral surface component and a stem component, wherein said stem component is adapted to be anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of a humerus bone.

30. (Currently amended) The humerus bone implant of claim 29 wherein said stem component has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

31. (Currently amended) The humerus bone implant of claim 30 wherein said stem component is linear.

32. (Cancelled)
